# nico_expected_machine (Data Source)

Expected Machine identifies a Machine that is expected to be discovered at a Site. Infrastructure Providers can pre-register Expected Machines using BMC credentials and serial numbers to help with Machine discovery and ingestion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_expected_machine" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "expected_machine_name" {
  value = data.nico_expected_machine.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site to filter Expected Machines by

### Read-Only

- `bmc_ip_address` (String) Optional BMC IP address (IPv4 or IPv6). When set, pre-allocates a reserved IP for the BMC.
- `bmc_mac_address` (String) MAC address of the Expected Machine's BMC (Baseboard Management Controller)
- `chassis_serial_number` (String) Serial number of the Expected Machine's chassis
- `created` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Machine was created
- `description` (String) Description of this component
- `fallback_dpu_serial_numbers` (List of String) Serial numbers of the Expected Machine's fallback DPUs (Data Processing Units)
- `host_id` (Number) Host ID within the tray
- `host_lifecycle_profile` (Attributes) Optional per-host lifecycle profile (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--host_lifecycle_profile))
- `is_dpf_enabled` (Boolean) When true, this host is eligible for DPF-based provisioning.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined key-value pairs for organizing and categorizing Expected Machines
- `machine` (Attributes) Machine information for this Expected Machine (populated when includeRelation=Machine is specified) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine))
- `machine_id` (String) Optional ID of the Machine associated with this Expected Machine
- `manufacturer` (String) Manufacturer of this component
- `model` (String) Model of this component
- `name` (String) Display name for this component
- `rack_id` (String) Optional rack identifier for this component
- `sku` (Attributes) SKU information for this Expected Machine (populated when includeRelation=Sku is specified) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku))
- `sku_id` (String) Optional ID of the SKU associated with this Expected Machine
- `slot_id` (Number) Slot ID within the rack
- `tray_idx` (Number) Tray index within the rack
- `updated` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Machine was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--host_lifecycle_profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `host_lifecycle_profile`

Read-Only:

- `disable_lockdown` (Boolean) When true, the server is not locked down during host lifecycle management. When omitted, the existing value is preserved.


<a id="nestedatt--machine"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machine`

Read-Only:

- `controller_machine_id` (String) ID of the Machine at Site, now same as the primary ID
- `controller_machine_type` (String) Denotes architecture (x86 vs ARM) of the Machine
- `hw_sku_device_type` (String) SKU derived device type of the machine, e.g. cpu, gpu, cache, storage, etc.
- `id` (String) Unique ID of Machine
- `maintenance_message` (String) If the Machine is in maintenance mode, this message will typically describe the reason and how long it is expected to be in maintenance
- `product_name` (String) Product name of the Machine
- `status` (String) Status represents the status of the machine
- `vendor` (String) Name of the vendor of the Machine

### Nested Schema for `sku`

Read-Only:

- `associated_machine_ids` (List of String) List of machine IDs associated with this SKU
- `components` (Attributes) Hardware components of this SKU (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku--components))
- `created` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the SKU was created
- `device_type` (String) Optional device type identifier (e.g. "gpu", "cpu", "storage")
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the SKU
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site this SKU belongs to
- `updated` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the SKU was last updated
